about: Dates bikes are not allowed on Metro trains (WMATA, Bikes on Metro Rail: 'Metro reserves the right to restrict bicycle access during special events or high passenger volume'; the owner, 2026-10-12: inaugurations, the 4th of July, Cherry Blossom peak bloom). Bikes are allowed on Metro at all times except these dates, so on them Own Bike + 🚆🚌 takes no Metro and says so; Bikeshare + 🚶🚆🚌 still walks onto Metro (core.transit.bike_blackout). Add a date by hand as {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "why": "..."}; recurring dates are MM-DD.
